content.value: Design an IoT-based Room Temperature Monitoring and Control System using. an (15) [CO3] ESP32 and a DHT22 sensor. The fan should start when temperature goes above $3 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ,$ speed gradually increasing from 50% to 100% as temperature rises from $3 0 \textdegree C$ to 50°C or above, using PWM control. Use Blynk IoT platform for remote temperature and fan monitoring. Provide necessary connection diagram, coding, and IoT server-node setup steps.
